description: Open-web retrospective research does not reproduce LexisNexis or systematic newspaper archive coverage. Weekly literal date queries, broad queries and follow-ups produced no defensible exhaustive inventory.

description: Early searches lack an individually recorded execution timestamp. Their log uses a documented first-research checkpoint rather than invented per-call clock precision.
required_followup: Retain checkpoint notes; future queries should record the clock at execution.
